name: 🍬 Grow A Candy
desc:
Inspired by Grow A Garden!

🍬🍫🍭🍬🍫🍭🍬🍫🍭🍬🍫🍭

Are you ready to grow your very own candy? Buy seeds from the shop when they restock, plant them, wait for them to grow, and collect the profits! Flex candy and finds on friends, and have fun!

[How To Plant]
• Equip your seed you want to plant!
• Click in your farm to plant!
• Wait to see it start growing!
• After its fully grown, it is time to harvest the goods!

Your garden grows while you are offline!
